title: Chapter 271 Invitation From Changping County
content:
Chapter 271 Invitation From Changping County

"Lord Wang Shuo, I heard that you have upgraded Wana Village to Wana Town and obtained the status of mayor. The resurrection of the undead is imminent, so I specially invite you to discuss the plan to fight against the undead!"

The signature is Lin Xiaodong, the magistrate of Changping County.

Wang Shuo fell into deep thought when he saw the news.

It is reasonable that Changping County noticed that he had broken through Nanshanji and made such a big fuss.

However, Wang Shuo was a little unsure about the attitude of Changping County!

What if this is a Hongmen Banquet, wouldn't he be walking into a trap?

After hesitating for a long time, Wang Shuo decided.

Ask Chang Gui first.

"Agui, do you think this is a Hongmen Banquet?"

The wooden head was expressionless, but the eyes on it blinked.

"Lord, it's hard to say! But I can pray for you."

"Is it enough to pray?"

Wang Shuo showed a contemptuous look.

"Don't I have a skill? It's similar to divination."

Wang Shuo was skeptical. This is a bit metaphysical!

But it doesn't hurt to give it a try!

"Well, pray for me quickly."

"Lord, this requires 1 soul crystal and 100 energy crystals."

Small money!

Wang Shuo agreed to Chang Gui's request without hesitation.

According to Chang Gui's request, they set up a simple dojo in an empty room in the lord's mansion.

After everything was ready, Chang Gui knelt on the futon, clasped his hands together, and was pious!

"My lord, is it dangerous to go to Changping County to keep the appointment this time?"

He was seen muttering something, and the offerings placed on the altar suddenly disappeared.

After a while, he opened his eyes.

"Lord, there is no danger on this trip."

Wang Shuo saw no changes except seeing the soul crystal and energy crystal disappear.

"That's it."

"Yeah, it's over."

"Which god are you worshipping?"

Chang Gui frowned, spread his hands, and whispered awkwardly: "Lord, I don't know either, but in the dark, an idea was born in my mind. I know the answer."

Wang Shuo's mouth twisted, and it turned out that those who pretended to be great gods were not reliable.

You still have to rely on yourself!

Wang Shuo thought about it carefully and decided to go and find out. If he didn't go, wouldn't he appear to be a coward?

Besides, he still had a resurrection coin, which was also considered an insurance.

Since he was going to discuss the big plan, it was obviously inappropriate to bring too many people.

So, he only brought Gong Zheng, Gu De, and Zou Yuanjie on this trip.

After taking a detour through Nanshan Market, Wang Shuo and the other four were teleported to Changping County.

The prosperity of Changping County is not comparable to Nanshan Market.

The streets are wide and straight, with shops on both sides, and people coming and going.

Wang Shuo stepped off the transport platform, and immediately two soldiers came over to question him.

"Where are you from? Come and register."

Wang Shuo looked closely and saw three civil servants not far away, who were in charge of registration.

"My name is Wang Shuo, and I came from Nanshan Market."

Wang Shuo did not hide anything, as this trip was an upright act.

He followed the soldiers and lined up at the registration office.

When it was his turn, he told the person in charge of registration his name again.

The registrar was stunned.

"Are you Wang Shuo?"

"Yes."

"The county magistrate has issued an order, and you can go to the lord's mansion on your own."

Wang Shuo heard this, and it seemed that the county magistrate had greeted this level of personnel.

He was not polite, asked for the direction, and walked straight ahead.

The lord's mansion of Changping County was also in the center. Along the way, Wang Shuo saw many vendors selling various supplies.

He thought that when he came out of the lord's mansion later, he must take a good look around to see if he could find any good things.
